## Context
Why the task exists, in 1-3 sentences: where it came from and what happens if it is not done.

## DoD
What we will see when the task is done, verifiably:
- artifacts (code, tests, a library or wrapper, an experiment report);
- measurable criteria where applicable (the number of covers on a test matrix, enumeration time);
- for research: what confirms the hypothesis and what refutes it.

Out of scope: …

## Plan
The steps in bullet points (one sentence for a small task), and the forks in the road that will have to be decided.

## Constraints and dependencies
Blocking issues (`#N`), external dependencies, decisions needed from the owner (e.g. a change of the public API,
the C ABI of `librunc.so` or the Python package).
